text.title: C# Background Services Procedure
text.summary: End-to-end 7-step procedure producing a worker spec + worker class + DI registration + xUnit test. Each step pairs typed input + bounded action + named output; steps with a decision-gate block until the gate passes.

step.name: classify-job-shape
step.action: Apply `content/06-decision-tree.xml`: durability needed? throughput? CPU-heavy? distributed? If durability=must-survive OR CPU=heavy → STOP and route to Hangfire / Quartz.NET / a separate Worker host.
step.decision-gate: If the decision is not in-process BackgroundService, STOP and apply the right component's methodology.

step.name: define-work-unit
step.action: Identify the atomic work unit and its idempotency key. Under at-least-once delivery the key is what makes a redelivered item safe.
step.decision-gate: An idempotency key must be nameable. If it is not, the work unit is not safely retryable — redesign before writing code.

step.name: design-channel-or-schedule
step.action: If a queue is needed: `Channel.CreateBounded<T>(capacity, FullMode=Wait)`. For fixed intervals: `PeriodicTimer` with an explicit period. For poll-based: a scoped query loop.

step.name: write-worker-class
step.input: Channel spec, scope strategy, work-unit contract
step.action: Class extends `BackgroundService`. Constructor: `IServiceProvider`, channel, `ILogger<T>`. `ExecuteAsync` loops `await foreach (var item in channel.Reader.ReadAllAsync(stoppingToken))` with `try/catch` per item, `CreateScope()` per item, and `BeginScope` carrying the entity id.

step.name: implement-retry-and-idempotency
step.action: Wrap the work unit in an explicit retry policy with bounded attempts and jitter; check the idempotency key before performing side effects so a redelivered item is a no-op.
step.decision-gate: Replaying the same item twice must leave the system in the same state. If it does not, do not proceed.

step.name: register-and-observe
step.action: In `Program.cs`: register the channel as a singleton, register an `IHealthCheck` tracking the last-success timestamp, `AddHostedService<T>()`, `AddHealthChecks().AddCheck<Health>("worker-name")`. Emit per-work-unit metrics (queue depth, processing time, failure rate) and traces.

step.name: test-shutdown-and-processing
step.action: xUnit test: instantiate the worker, write to the channel, call `StartAsync`, wait for the handler, `StopAsync`. Separately send SIGTERM mid-batch and assert the drain completes within the bounded shutdown window.
step.decision-gate: If the worker does not exit within 1s of `StopAsync`, the `pass-stoppingtoken` rule is violated — fix before merge.

section.title: Failure handling
section.p: If a decision-gate blocks, do NOT proceed to the next step. Surface the blockage to the owner with the specific input that did not satisfy the gate. Resume only after the input is corrected.
